key_insight: PyraTok introduces a pyramidal, language-aligned tokenizer that produces semantically structured discrete tokens at multiple spatiotemporal resolutions, improving cross-modal alignment and zero-shot transfer for video understanding and generation.
problem_solved: Single-scale codebooks with limited vocabularies and weak language supervision yield poor alignment between video tokens and text, hindering generalization and zero-shot capabilities in text-to-video and video understanding systems.
method: Pyramidal tokenization: learn discrete latents at multiple spatiotemporal scales (coarse → fine) so different token levels capture global semantics vs. fine-grained motion/texture.
Language alignment: align token-level embeddings with text (captions/semantic supervision) so codebooks become semantically meaningful and cross-modal compatible.

VAE-based backbone + multimodal training: build on a pretrained video VAE and finetune its quantized latents with multimodal objectives to produce structured, reusable codebooks for generation and retrieval.
impact: PyraTok enables more semantically faithful video tokens that improve text-to-video generation quality and zero-shot video understanding/transfer, offering practitioners a scalable tokenizer design for stronger multimodal models.

paper_title: PyraTok: Language-Aligned Pyramidal Tokenizer for Video Understanding and Generation
paper_authors: Onkar Susladkar, Tushar Prakash, Adheesh Juvekar, Kiet A. Nguyen, Dong-Hwan Jang
